back: A loss or difference in how part of the body or mind works.
The disadvantage when an impairment meets barriers in society that prevent equal participation.
The view that disability is a problem in the individual's body to be treated or cured.
The view that much disability is created by barriers in society, which can be removed.

front: Name the main types of disability.
back: Physical, visual, hearing, intellectual, mental health conditions, albinism (often discussed with disability) and multiple.

front: Name five real causes of disability.
back: Genetic conditions, disease, accidents, malnutrition and birth complications (also conflict, such as landmines).
An inherited condition in which the body makes little melanin; it is not an illness or a curse.

front: Why is a belief in curses or witchcraft as a cause of disability harmful?
back: It blames innocent people, can lead to hiding or neglect, and delays medical care and support.
Language that puts the person before the condition, such as "a person with a disability".
